messages:
sara-w: quick question - noticed a small, persistent uptick in 502s for /v1/generate and /v1/stream endpoints since ~09:00 UTC. not huge, but steady. where's the fastest place to grab a few request ids + sample traces? also thinking about alert debounce but want evidence first.
jamal: start with the ingress errors dash -> Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ingress-errors   it has a breakdown by route + upstream. add filter: status:502 and group by client_ip to see burstiness.
mika: logs are in Loki -> query: `{app="gateway", level="error"} |= "502" |= "request_id"` then `| json` to extract request_id. quick snippet:```loki
{app="gateway"} |= "502" | json | line_format "${request_id} ${duration_ms} ${upstream}"```
Use the request_id to pull traces.
observability-bot: Automated hint: trace sampling rate for gateway is 25% by default. Use /traces?request_id= to fetch any archived spans: https://traces.redwood.internal/search?request_id=
jamal: if you want a small sample set, run a narrow logs query for a 10m window around the spike and limit 20 results. then hit the trace service or Jaeger link from the log line.
tom-g: for alert tuning, check the current alert window: PagerDuty alert is firing on `rate(ingress_5xx_total[1m]) > 0.5` for 5xx across prod. that's pretty sensitive. I'd suggest trying a 5m window and ignoring single-route small bursts: example alert suggestion:```yaml
alert: HighIngress5xxRate
expr: sum by (route) (increase(ingress_5xx_total[5m])) / sum by (route) (increase(ingress_requests_total[5m])) > 0.02
for: 10m
```
This yields fewer noisy pages.
lina: also worth checking upstream timeouts: look at proxy timeout metric `upstream_timeout_total` split by upstream_service. timeouts + 502s together often mean overloaded backend rather than gateway config.
sara-w: thanks — couple follow-ups: 1) does anyone have a saved Grafana panel link for the 502 heatmap by route? 2) if we pick a 10m debounce + 10m for `for:` does that sound safe for prod?
mika: saved panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ingress-errors?view=route-heatmap (bookmark it). 10m debounce + 10m `for:` is reasonable to avoid paging on short-lived downstream flaps, but for critical customers we should keep shorter. maybe keep notification level: page only if `impact_score > 0.2` (see ops runbook).
jamal: echo on mika — start with a mute rule for noisy route (if it's one customer) and try the 10m debounce in staging for a week. we can roll to prod if noise drops.
sara-w: I'll collect 10 sample request_ids and traces and post them here. planning to propose the 5m -> 10m alert change in the next ops sync. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
observability-bot: Reminder: if you attach logs/traces here, redact PII and API keys per company policy.
